title: Target-context gate before transfer
abstract: A synthetic primary decision object that requires the receiving context to contain and expose the state required by the proposed mechanism before any transfer recommendation is considered.
disposition_reason: The gate prevents source-system precedent from being treated as direct support in a mismatched receiving context.
nearest_prior_art: Context-dependent transfer rules described at component level.
strongest_reason: It turns an implicit transfer assumption into a falsifiable prerequisite.
weakest_causal_edge: The relevant receiving-context state may not be measurable with sufficient specificity.
pairwise_summary: Not pairwise-ranked in this focused decision run.
reviewer_critiques: Analogical evidence must remain labeled as analogical.
The gate must be measured before outcome interpretation.
finalist_reason: Featured as the primary decision object without finalist or validation status.
reentry_condition: Resolve the open context measurement before testing.
scientific_summary: Transfer should proceed only when the receiving context exposes the state required by the mechanism.
causal_mechanism: A context gate determines whether the proposed route is physically and biologically available in the receiving system.
next_discriminating_experiment: Measure the required context state and compare state-positive, state-negative, and burden-matched conditions.
